items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide; public exposure and security-sensitive releases remain blocked; ordinary reversible growth is conditional. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deployment controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unevidenced. No incident or exploit signal is evidenced, but missing telemetry is not evidence of absence. Compliance is technical-only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. TLS evidence shows no certificates expiring within 30 days only and does not establish complete TLS safety. Risk severity is high for public exposure or security-sensitive releases and medium for bounded changes that add no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: continue containment-only execution, preserve private launch gates, admit no new security-sensitive work, and continue only existing read-only evidence capture and approved measurement or repair work.

Continue the existing read-only fleet security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated, redacted evidence or explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue unchanged work, exploit targets, or conduct external outreach.
